reason: I'm not adding some new bot into my work groups where every transfer screenshot and supplier bill sits, and then also signing it into my Google account. The receipts are a pain, but my manager and I sort them on a Sunday and it works well enough.
objection: Who is behind this bot and will it still exist in a year? If it disappears or gets sold, it has already read all my business chats and has access to my Drive.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another café owner I know in Bali use it for a few months without problems, plus a clear way to cut its access and delete my data in one tap.
